title: Yb:YAG multipass CPA amplifier
summary: A 250 fs, 1 µJ seed at 10 kHz is stretched to 431 ps, amplified in 8 passes through a 6 mm Yb:YAG rod pumped with 150 W of cw diode light to 1.46 mJ (gain 2000) and recompressed to 535 fs, at the transform limit (Strehl 0.999) after 1.04 mJ of grating throughput.
